beats.narration_text: Hello — this is Liam, in for Bear. Jiean Yin's game is Lane Tactics: wooden pieces on a five-lane board, and you win by reaching the enemy's back row. This assignment adds three 3D assets, built in Blender by Claude through the Blender MCP. The prompt on screen is an illustrative reconstruction.

shot.label: Illustrative reconstruction of the Claude interface — not a transcript

props.segment: A Piece, a Square, a Goal
props.command: Please use Walker to convert my game design document about Lane Tactics — carved wooden pieces on a five-lane linen board, win by standing a piece on the enemy's back row — into three low-poly 3D assets: the archer piece, a board square and the goal flag. Build them in Blender through the MCP, export them to Godot, and check them in a small tabletop scene.

beats.narration_text: Here they are, in Jiean's own Godot screenshot. The archer piece is the unit. The board square is the tile the five-lane board is made of. The goal flag marks the back row you have to reach. The brief fixed one scale before any build: one square is one metre, and every origin sits at the base.

beats.narration_text: Then the numbers. The check loads each model, then the diorama, and measures. Line 173, await process frame, is the fix. The first version measured before the nodes were in the scene tree, so every position read as zero and the camera had no frustum. One impossible failure, all three assets at x zero, gave it away.

props.title: check_assets.gd: Measure Only Inside the Tree
props.code:
var scene: Node3D = packed.instantiate() as Node3D
	root.add_child(scene)
	await process_frame
	if not rep.check("diorama: scene is inside the tree before measuring", scene.is_inside_tree()):
		return

	var floor_node: MeshInstance3D = scene.get_node("Floor") as MeshInstance3D
	var floor_box: AABB = floor_node.global_transform * floor_node.get_aabb()
	var floor_top: float = floor_box.end.y
	var cam: Camera3D = scene.get_node("Camera3D") as Camera3D
	rep.check("diorama: camera has a real frustum (6 planes), so the view check can mean something",
		cam.get_frustum().size() == 6, "%d planes" % cam.get_frustum().size())

beats.narration_text: Verdict. Checked: size, upright, scale, origin, budget and colours, headlessly, plus this scripted look at the running scene. Claude got three things wrong: the bow hid the eye, the first check proved less than it claimed, and the flag vanishes side-on, still unfixed. Uncertain: how they read at game distance, and why the linen looks so pale. Next step: Jiean's own look check in Godot.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this. Use Walker on my Lane Tactics goal flag: make the cloth six centimetres thick instead of two. The catch: the numbers may not move at all. Only looking will tell you. Liam, in for Bear.
